subject: Civil Engineering
title: What Construction Management Is
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Construction Management Is.

hook.text: Building a skyscraper takes 10,000 workers, 200 subcontractors, and 3 years. Someone must coordinate.

buildup.text: Construction management plans, schedules, budgets, and controls the entire building process.

discovery.text: The CM balances scope, time, cost, and quality — changing one affects all the others.

twist.text: 90% of construction projects exceed their original budget or schedule — management is hard.

climax.text: Great construction management saved the Empire State Building — built in just 410 days.

punchline.text: Engineering designs the structure. Management builds it on time and on budget.

quiz.question: What four constraints does a construction manager balance?
